rule: A parameter has a value only when a citation is recorded for it. Otherwise value is null and status explains why. Null values are excluded from scoring, never treated as zero.
coordinate_warning: Region coordinates verified against IAU Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature (https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/).

regions.name: Shackleton Crater (lunar south pole)
regions.description: Permanently shadowed crater at the lunar south pole. Candidate reference for polar base studies.

elevation_m.source: Zuber, M.T. et al. (2012), Constraints on the volatile distribution within Shackleton crater at the lunar south pole, Nature, 486, 378–381, DOI: 10.1038/nature11216

slope_deg.source: Zuber, M.T. et al. (2012), Constraints on the volatile distribution within Shackleton crater at the lunar south pole, Nature, 486, 378–381, DOI: 10.1038/nature11216

roughness_m.status: not in reference data: LOLA RMS roughness varies by baseline scale (Hurst exponent H~0.95, Rosenburg et al. 2011)

temp_mean_c.source: Paige, D.A. et al. (2010), Diviner Lunar Radiometer Observations of Cold Traps in the Moon's South Polar Region, Science, 330(6003), 479–482, DOI: 10.1126/science.1187726

precip_mm_yr.status: not applicable: the Moon has no precipitation

rh_mean_pct.status: not applicable: the Moon has no atmosphere to hold humidity

ndvi.status: not applicable: no vegetation on the Moon

geology_class.source: Zuber, M.T. et al. (2012), Nature, 486, 378–381, DOI: 10.1038/nature11216
